description: Allows the addition, modification and deletion of binding rules in a Consul cluster using the agent. For more details on using and configuring binding rules, see https://developer.hashicorp.com/consul/api-docs/acl/binding-rules.

parameters.name: auth_method
parameters.description: The name of the auth method that this rule applies to.

parameters.name: bind_name
parameters.description: The name to bind to a token at login-time. What it binds to can be adjusted with different values of the bind_type parameter.

parameters.name: bind_type
parameters.description: Specifies the way the binding rule affects a token created at login. Choices: "service" "node" "role" "templated-policy"

parameters.name: bind_vars
parameters.description: Specifies the templated policy variables when bind_type is set to templated-policy.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA bundle to use for https connections.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Free form human readable description of the binding rule.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Host of the Consul agent. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Specifies a name for the binding rule. Note: This is used to identify the binding rule. But since the API does not support a name, it is prefixed to the description.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port on which the consul agent is running. Default: 8500

parameters.name: scheme
parameters.description: The protocol scheme on which the Consul agent is running. Defaults to http and can be set to https for secure connections. Default: "http"

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Specifies the expression used to match this rule against valid identities returned from an auth method validation. If empty this binding rule matches all valid identities returned from the auth method.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the binding rule should be present or absent. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token to use for authorization.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the Consul agent. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create a binding rule
  community.general.consul_binding_rule:
    name: my_name
    description: example rule
    auth_method: minikube
    bind_type: service
    bind_name: "{{ serviceaccount.name }}"
    token: "{{ consul_management_token }}"

- name: Remove a binding rule
  community.general.consul_binding_rule:
    name: my_name
    auth_method: minikube
    state: absent

return_values.name: binding_rule
return_values.description: The binding rule as returned by the Consul HTTP API. Returned: always Sample: {"AuthMethod": "minikube", "BindName": "{{ serviceaccount.name }}", "BindType": "service", "CreateIndex": 30, "Description": "my_name: example rule", "ID": "59c8a237-e481-4239-9202-45f117950c5f", "ModifyIndex": 33, "Selector": "serviceaccount.namespace==default"}

return_values.name: operation
return_values.description: The operation performed. Returned: changed Sample: "update"
